generated.what_happened: The U.S. Treasury Department has automatically enrolled more than 60 million children under age 18 into "Trump Accounts," which are designed to function similarly to individual retirement accounts and invest money in the stock market. Children born between 2025 and 2028 qualify for an automatic $1,000 government seed contribution, while certain eligible older children can receive $250 through private donations. To activate the accounts and claim seed funds, parents must download an app, verify their identity, and submit an IRS form. The accounts accept contributions from family, employers, and charities, with withdrawals generally intended for retirement or qualified expenses such as higher education and home purchases.
